ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Nimgrab Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of nimgrab, a tool bundled with the Nim programming framework and used for downloading files.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\nimgrab\\\.exe$") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=2DD44C3C29D667F5C0EF5F9D7C7FFB8B.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=F266609E91985F0FE3E31C5E8FAEEEC4FFA5E0322D8B6F15FE69F4C5165B9559.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=C07FDDD21D123EA9B3A08EEF44AAAC45.*")))
